assessments.evidence: M.Sc. Computer Science, Technical University of Munich | 2016 - 2018. Thesis: "Neural Information Retrieval for Technical Documentation" (grade 1.3)
assessments.comment: Holds a Master's degree in Computer Science from a well-regarded university, fully satisfying this requirement.

assessments.evidence: Software engineer with 7 years of professional experience [...] Junior Developer Brightpath Digital 09/2018 - 07/2019 / Software Engineer Quantell Systems 08/2019 - 03/2023 / Senior Software Engineer Helios Mobility 04/2023 - today
assessments.comment: Seven years of continuous professional software engineering experience across three roles is clearly evidenced.

assessments.evidence: the last 3 years focused on building and operating LLM-based products [...] Senior Software Engineer, AI Products, Helios Mobility SE [...] 04/2023 - today
assessments.comment: Over two years (April 2023 to present) of hands-on production LLM work is explicitly stated and corroborated by detailed project descriptions.

assessments.evidence: Python (expert; typing, asyncio, Poetry, pytest) [...] Introduced typed Python (mypy strict mode) and packaging standards (Poetry) across the team [...] Developed a FastAPI-based internal API layer with full pytest coverage (about 90 %) and async endpoints.
assessments.comment: Expert-level Python with explicit coverage of typing, async, packaging (Poetry), and pytest is thoroughly evidenced across the CV.

assessments.evidence: Built tool-using agents with Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock (Claude models) [...] Implemented Amazon Bedrock Guardrails [...] observability with CloudWatch and Langfuse [...] AWS (Bedrock, ECS Fargate, Lambda, OpenSearch Serverless, RDS, CloudWatch)
assessments.comment: Extensive, named production use of Amazon Bedrock including deployment, guardrails, and monitoring is explicitly described.

assessments.evidence: Designed the retrieval stack: OpenSearch Serverless with hybrid (BM25 + kNN) search, Amazon Titan and Cohere embeddings [...] RDS PostgreSQL with pgvector for similarity search on sensor signatures.
assessments.comment: Direct production experience with both OpenSearch and pgvector, plus multiple embedding models, fully satisfies this requirement.

assessments.evidence: Set up the LLM evaluation pipeline: curated 1,800-item golden dataset, RAGAS metrics (faithfulness, context precision), LLM-as-a-judge scoring, and nightly regression runs in GitHub Actions that block prompt or model changes on metric drops.
assessments.comment: Comprehensive, production-grade LLM evaluation experience covering RAGAS, custom LLM judges, and automated regression gating is explicitly described.

assessments.evidence: Infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) for all services [...] managed deployments with Terraform.
assessments.comment: Both AWS CDK and Terraform are explicitly mentioned as tools used in production across two different roles.

assessments.evidence: CI/CD with GitHub Actions [...] nightly regression runs in GitHub Actions that block prompt or model changes on metric drops.
assessments.comment: GitHub Actions is used for both standard CI/CD and automated LLM evaluation gating, providing strong evidence.

assessments.evidence: German: B2 (Goethe-Zertifikat B2, 2022; currently attending a C1 course)
assessments.comment: German is only at B2 level (certified); the candidate is working towards C1 but has not yet achieved it, falling short of the C1 requirement.
English is stated as C2/native-level, well above the C1 threshold required.

assessments.evidence: Munich area, Germany [...] Open to hybrid work in Munich.
assessments.comment: The candidate is based in the Munich area and explicitly open to hybrid work in Munich, making two days on-site very plausible, though the exact two-day commitment is not explicitly confirmed.

assessments.evidence: Built tool-using agents with Strands Agents and Amazon Bedrock (Claude models) for warranty-claim triage [...] LLM and ML: Amazon Bedrock, Claude and Titan models, Strands Agents, LangChain
assessments.comment: Strands Agents is explicitly used in a production agent system, and LangChain is also listed, fully meeting this requirement.

assessments.evidence: AWS (Bedrock, ECS Fargate, Lambda, OpenSearch Serverless, RDS, CloudWatch) [...] Containerised services with Docker
assessments.comment: Experience is with ECS Fargate (container orchestration) and Docker, but no mention of Kubernetes or EKS specifically.
Model Context Protocol (MCP) and building MCP servers are not mentioned anywhere in the CV.
Hugging Face is listed but only for inference; no mention of fine-tuning, LoRA, QLoRA, or PyTorch training workflows.

assessments.evidence: Helios Mobility SE (automotive supplier), Stuttgart [...] Implemented Amazon Bedrock Guardrails (PII masking, denied topics) and structured audit logging to satisfy the group's GDPR requirements.
assessments.comment: The candidate has direct experience in the automotive industry with explicit compliance and regulatory considerations (GDPR, audit logging).

assessments.evidence: AWS Certified Solutions Architect - Associate (2022) / AWS Certified Developer - Associate (2021)
assessments.comment: Holds the AWS Solutions Architect Associate certification (one of the two named certifications), but not the Machine Learning Specialty.

assessments.evidence: TypeScript (good) [...] Infrastructure as code with AWS CDK (TypeScript) for all services [...] Junior Developer Brightpath Digital [...] TypeScript (React) for e-commerce clients.
assessments.comment: TypeScript is used for AWS CDK infrastructure code and was also used in a prior full-stack role, providing solid practical familiarity.

additional_strengths: Published speaker at PyCon DE 2025 on enterprise RAG evaluation, demonstrating thought leadership and community engagement.
Production experience with Langfuse for LLM observability and tracing, a valuable operational skill not mentioned in the job description.
GDPR compliance implementation (PII masking via Bedrock Guardrails, structured audit logging) in a large enterprise context.
Experience with large-scale data engineering (Apache Airflow, Apache Spark on EMR) feeding 30+ manufacturing plants, broadening platform skills.
Technical mentoring experience (working student mentorship, weekly code review sessions), indicating seniority and team-building capability.
